title: Make one real workload observable
hook: Take the week’s practice into a tool someone actually uses. Show the decision and measure whether it helps.

project.brief: Choose an existing personal project with a queue, expensive background work or a hard-to-debug state transition. Identify the person waiting and a measurable problem before changing code. Check who benefits and who could be harmed. Use synthetic data for public evidence.
project.deliverable: A pull request or commit with one behavior change, a snapshot emitted by the real code, a regression test and a short before/after note. Record time saved or failures avoided, operating cost, and any new risk. If the evidence does not justify a change, ship the measurement and explain that decision.
suggestions: Evolve LLM: make a model-loading or cancellation transition inspectable.
Evolve Jobs: inspect a search/match decision using synthetic listings, without submitting applications.
Site delivery: expose a failover decision and reproduce a recovery case locally.

disclosure: This weekly project is separate from the daily mission. Its XP is self-reported from the work link; the game does not inspect the pull request or judge its impact. Use a personal repository or an authorized work task, and remove private data before sharing.
